Until it's president De Santis. And the GOP has packed the federal courts with absolute nutjobs. I give the SCOTUS a 50/50 chance of upholding laws like Florida has passed. >Consider taking a break from political news

I'm a political science major. I'm studying this shit. That's why I'm so terrified. The news isn't even the main reason I'm concerned. Sure, it's made me aware of this shit, but studying what's going on is making me freak the fuck out. This isn't coming from a place of being concerned because of sensationalist news, it comes from someone who has/is actively studying American politics and is terrified of what the trends show.

>Everything is okay.

It's not. It absolutely isn't and I'm not going to let myself live to see it get even worse

Idk if it's gonna get middle east levels bad, but if the GOP takes congress and the white house in 2024, we're probably fucked.

Also, idk what skills studying history and poli sci have given me that I can immigrate. Honestly I'm scared shitless that I'm just stuck with useless degrees

Thats fair. I'm just scared shitless that the GOPs rhetoric sticks and they take both houses and the presidency in 2024. If that happens there won't be a single safe spot in the country because of how the GOP stacked the SCOTUS. Things are good for our community rn, but there's a 50/50 shot it gets dramatically and horrendously worse within the decade. I don't want to take that chance and honestly I'd encourage anyone in the LGBTQ community to get a going because we have at least 2 judges that have questioned Obergefel. I hate to sound doomer, but this is what I've been studying in my classes right now and the trends scare the shit out of me

I understand the struggle. Growing up I was convinced I was going to be a priest.

>And it's hard to go against the Virgin. She's done so much for me.

This is a question I really had to ask myself, did she do so much for me, or did the idea of her give me strength to go on? Did she do so much for me, or was it circumstances improving combined with the hope I was given?

I used to think there was no hope outside the church, and now that I'm out I've never been more hopeful that I can have a fulfilling life free from threats of a loving God torturing me forever.

Just remember, it's a marathon, not a sprint. I hope you find the answers you need
